content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "High frequency of CT/MRI scans",
      "quote": "CT/MRI",
      "page": 52,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "CT/MRI is scheduled every 4 months for years 1 and 2, and every 6 months in year 3, which is a high frequency of imaging and may be burdensome for patients and sites.",
      "fix": "Consider reducing imaging frequency, e.g., to every 6 months in years 1-2, or align with standard of care."
    },
    {
      "title": "ADA sample not collected in year 3",
      "quote": "ADA Sample | X |",
      "page": 52,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "ADA sample is only collected in years 1-2, but immunogenicity monitoring should continue throughout the treatment period, including year 3, to detect late-onset ADA.",
      "fix": "Add ADA sample collection in year 3 visits."
    },
    {
      "title": "Tight window for vital signs post-infusion",
      "quote": "The allowable window for each specified time point is ±10 minutes.",
      "page": 59,
      "section": "9.2.3.1 Vital Signs",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "A ±10 minute window for post-infusion vital signs is very tight and may be difficult for sites to meet, especially if infusion runs long or other procedures overlap.",
      "fix": "Widen the window to ±15 or ±20 minutes for post-infusion vital signs."
    },
    {
      "title": "Overloaded visits with many procedures",
      "quote": "Complete Physical Examination and ECOG PS | X | X",
      "page": 52,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "Each visit includes physical exam, vital signs, hematology, blood chemistry, TSH, CT/MRI, ctDNA, and PROs, which is a heavy burden for patients and site staff.",
      "fix": "Consider moving some procedures (e.g., TSH, ctDNA) to alternate visits or reducing frequency."
    },
    {
      "title": "CT/MRI required for secondary endpoints but not clearly scheduled",
      "quote": "Secondary endpoints regarding response rate per RECIST 1.1 prior to surgery and regarding disease-free survival after surgery require imaging studies.",
      "page": 54,
      "section": "9.2.2 Efficacy Procedures",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The text states imaging is required for secondary endpoints, but the Schedule of Activities only shows CT/MRI during treatment, not after surgery for disease-free survival follow-up.",
      "fix": "Clarify and add imaging assessments for post-surgery follow-up in the Schedule of Activities."
    },
    {
      "title": "PROs not listed in Schedule of Activities",
      "quote": "Patient reported outcomes will be measured at a frequency indicated in Table 2 and Table 3 using the self-administered EORTC QLQ-C30.",
      "page": 65,
      "section": "9.2.9 Patient Reported Outcomes",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The Schedule of Activities (Table 2/3) does not include a row for PROs, making it unclear when the EORTC QLQ-C30 is to be administered.",
      "fix": "Add a PRO row to the Schedule of Activities with visit frequency."
    },
    {
      "title": "ECG only at time points according to Table 2",
      "quote": "A standard 12-lead ECG will be performed at time points according to Table 2.",
      "page": 60,
      "section": "9.2.3.3 Electrocardiogram",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The Schedule of Activities does not include an ECG row, so it is unclear when ECGs are performed, which may lead to missed assessments.",
      "fix": "Add ECG to the Schedule of Activities with specific visit time points."
    },
    {
      "title": "Screening procedures not fully listed in Schedule",
      "quote": "The following procedures will be performed for the sole purpose of determining study eligibility or characterizing the baseline population:",
      "page": 54,
      "section": "9.2.1 Procedures Performed Only at the Screening/Baseline Visit",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The Schedule of Activities does not include a screening column or list these screening-only procedures, making it difficult for sites to plan the screening visit.",
      "fix": "Add a screening column to the Schedule of Activities and include all screening procedures."
    }
  ]
}
